note: Primitive Cherokee NF campground beside the Tellico River at the Tennessee-North Carolina line, about 17 miles up FR 210 (Tellico River Road) from Tellico Plains. Each site has two picnic tables, two lantern posts and a grill/fire ring. --Claude
summary: State Line (Cherokee NF): FS page + rec.gov FCFS listing + Esri/3DEP. Open, year-round, FCFS only, $10/$20 by party size, vault toilets, no water, sites hold two 26-ft trailers; Discount Passes do not apply. Riverfront not supported: river well under 30 m and FR 210 appears to run between the camp and the channel.
flags: WATERFRONT riverfront -> not waterfront (proposed; downgrade without asking per default-down). The Tellico here is a mountain stream well under ~30 m wide, so 'riverfront' is the wrong tier regardless; creekside would need an easy walk down with nothing between. The stored evidence quote 'sites located along the water' is NOT on the current FS page (it says only 'Located adjacent to Tellico River'). Imagery is canopy-blind at the pads; the leaf-off tile just east shows FR 210 running along the north bank, and 3DEP puts the channel ~70-80 m south of the pin, so the forest road most likely runs between the camp and the river. No site numbers, no per-site map, no rec.gov shoreline flags. If a site map later shows pads between FR 210 and the river, 'creekside' would fit.
